ags: AGS shell styles. Retired with the move to Qreep.
bat: Syntax theme for bat, plus a matching delta config; rebuilds bat's cache.
btop: System monitor theme; tells a running btop to reload.
claimed-bloom: Theme for claimed-bloom itself, so the inspector wears the bloom it inspects.
dbeaver: Database GUI colours, applied by the dbeaver-theme repo's script.
fovia: FoviaSprout surfaces: Fovian QML colours and Fovia Web CSS variables.
ghostty: Terminal theme. One of the main visible targets.
gimp: Colour layer for the Adart-Moonmix GIMP theme.
gtk: GTK colours. Still depends on the sibling GTK skeleton; supervised visitation, see docs/gtk.md.
gum: Shell theme for gum, used by gummy-spore and other scripts.
hyprlock: Lock screen config plus a prepared gap/blur background, see docs/hyprlock.md.
iced: App target for Iced-based UI experiments. Retired.
icons: Papirus-based icon recolouring through adart-matugener-icons. Icons still do icon things.
kitty: Terminal theme, including SSH and SSH-prod variants; reloads kitty with SIGUSR1.
lazygit: Git TUI theme, merged in through LG_CONFIG_FILE.
logseq: Splices a colour block into Logseq's custom.css.
mycli: MySQL/MariaDB CLI colours. Terminal database comfort.
oh-my-posh: Prompt theme extending the base config with the bloom palette.
potato: Health/overthinking tracker theme; runs potato-sync. The name is ridiculous. This is not a bug.
qreep: Colours for Qreep, the quickshell shell that also hosts the bloom OSD.
qt6ct: Qt colour scheme; nudges qt6ct to reload.
sqlit: SQL TUI theme. More database colour diplomacy.
superfile: Terminal file manager theme, selected without replacing the rest of Superfile's config.
wlogout: Logout menu. Dramatic exit, but themed.
yazi: Terminal file manager theme. Because previews deserve atmosphere too.
zsh: Fast-syntax-highlighting theme and shell colour variables.
